context_for_next_testing_agent: File upload bug is FIXED. The '[object Object]' error no longer appears. Key fixes: 1) Frontend uses FormData instead of JSON for upload, 2) Error extraction handles array/object/string detail from 422 responses, 3) Response field mapping fixed (file_name vs filename, size vs file_size, uploaded_at vs created_at), 4) Backend excludes _id from upload response.

rca_of_the_issue.root_cause: Frontend was sending JSON Content-Type but backend expected Form data (FastAPI Form(...) params). This caused 422 Unprocessable Entity. The 422 response detail is an array of validation error objects, which when passed directly to Error constructor produced '[object Object],[object Object]...'
fix_applied: Changed frontend fileService.uploadFile to use FormData instead of JSON
Improved error message extraction to handle detail as array/object/string
Fixed response field name mapping in listFiles (file_name, size, uploaded_at)
Fixed upload response parsing (data.file.id vs data.file_id)
Backend excludes _id from upload response to prevent serialization issues
rca_of_the_issue.verification: Uploaded test file successfully, no error messages shown, file appears in list with correct metadata
